lines.say: 34 tools, / 27 blend modes, / and not one line / of Adobe code.
This is PhotoCraft, / Photoshop rebuilt / from scratch / in pure Rust.
If you know Photoshop, / you already know it. / Every menu and shortcut / sits where you expect.
Every button runs / one of 500+ commands, / and the command line / and AI agents / call the same ones.
It opens / real Photoshop files, / and re-saves / 307 of 309 / with the same render. / All 116 shape layers / match Photoshop's pixels.
It draws on the GPU, / without Electron. / A radius-180 blur / on 3.6 megapixels / takes under a second.
Every filter / previews live / on the canvas, / only inside / your selection.
Under the hood / sit 24 crates / and over 1,700 tests.
It is early alpha, / and the team says so: / not yet a replacement / for daily pro work.
It runs on Mac, / Windows and Linux, / even in the browser. / Clone it / and cargo run.
Send this / to a designer / who wants a free, / open-source Photoshop.
PhotoCraft. / Free, open source, / and pure Rust.
